# profile open value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:profileOpenValue`](gmeow-profileOpenValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/profileOpenValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/profiles`](../../slices/profiles.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An open value-vocabulary class (instances are individuals, never subclasses) used by this [`Profile`](../classes/gmeow-Profile.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Profile`](../classes/gmeow-Profile.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:profileOpenValue`](gmeow-profileOpenValue.md) from [`gmeow:Profile`](../classes/gmeow-Profile.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/profiles/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos:  <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .



# --- The Profile: a closed descriptor schema for a tagging. It SELF-DESCRIBES —
#     naming the class it governs (profileAppliesTo gmeow:Tagging), the
#     descriptor properties (profileDescriptor), and the open value class
#     (profileOpenValue gmeow:Tag) — so tooling reads the graph, not code. A
#     Profile MUST carry a skos:definition.
ex:profileTagging a gmeow:Profile ;
    rdfs:label "Tagging Profile"@en ;
    skos:definition "The closed descriptor schema for a reified tagging: the entity tagged, the tag applied (drawn from the open gmeow:Tag vocabulary), the agent who applied it, and the scheme it belongs to. New tags extend the facet as data added to the open value class, with this descriptor set unchanged."@en ;
    gmeow:profileAppliesTo gmeow:Tagging ;
    gmeow:profileDescriptor
        gmeow:taggingTagged ,
        gmeow:taggingTag ,
        gmeow:taggingTagger ,
        gmeow:taggingScheme ;
    gmeow:profileOpenValue gmeow:Tag .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`Profile`](../classes/gmeow-Profile.md) to name an open value-vocabulary class (instances are individuals) whose members supply values for one of the [`Profile`](../classes/gmeow-Profile.md)'s descriptor properties.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a descriptor property itself (that is [`gmeow:profileDescriptor`](gmeow-profileDescriptor.md)) and avoid pointing it at a class meant to be extended by subclassing rather than by minting individuals.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:profileOpenValue`](gmeow-profileOpenValue.md) from the [`Profile`](../classes/gmeow-Profile.md) to each open value class; extension then happens by adding individuals to those classes, never by altering the closed descriptor schema.
